comment: save.c saveobjchn() 783-795 and restore.c restobjchn() 283-290, for a floor object on another level. A debug Valkyrie travels to the Dlvl 1 downstairs, drops one of her two food rations there, creates a newt beside her and starts eating the floor ration; the newt interrupts at once, leaving the partly eaten ration svc.context.victual.piece. She goes down the stairs, so goto_level()'s savelev() releases Dlvl 1 and saveobjchn() nulls the pointer and keeps the ration's o_id, and she saves on Dlvl 2. The second segment restores, keeps no save file and climbs back up: getlev()'s restobjchn() finds the o_id on Dlvl 1 and makes the ration victual.piece again, so eating it resumes the meal ("You resume your meal."). Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
